All bugs in `tally/` have been fixed and `tally/schedule.py` has been implemented according to [SCHEDULE.md](file:///tmp/canary-neon-ksezavq0/task/SCHEDULE.md):

- [allocate.py](file:///tmp/canary-neon-ksezavq0/task/tally/allocate.py): Fixed `allocate_units` to use exact `Fraction` arithmetic, floor shares, distribute leftover units by largest remainder (breaking ties toward later shares), handle negative totals by negating the split of `abs(total)`, and reject non-finite/negative/all-zero weights.
- [duration.py](file:///tmp/canary-neon-ksezavq0/task/tally/duration.py): Fixed `parse` to match the full string, allow upper/lower-case `d`/`h`/`m`/`s`, enforce largest-unit-first ordering with at most one occurrence per unit, and reject trailing junk or invalid formats.
- [fields.py](file:///tmp/canary-neon-ksezavq0/task/tally/fields.py): Rewrote `parse_fields` to properly handle quoted values (preserving internal whitespace, `SEP`, and `=`, and unescaping doubled `QUOTE` characters), reject unclosed quotes, trailing characters after closing quotes, empty keys, fields without `=`, and duplicate keys.
- [intervals.py](file:///tmp/canary-neon-ksezavq0/task/tally/intervals.py): Fixed `merge` to validate `start <= end`, sort intervals, and merge touching intervals (`start <= prev_end`); fixed `free_slots` to clamp busy intervals to `[day_start, day_end)` and keep gaps with length `>= min_length`.
- [ledger.py](file:///tmp/canary-neon-ksezavq0/task/tally/ledger.py): Fixed `bill` to match client names case-insensitively with trimmed spaces while preserving first-seen spelling and order, compute the total charge once from exact total seconds using `Fraction` with exact halves rounded up, and return `0` for all clients when total time is zero.
- [schedule.py](file:///tmp/canary-neon-ksezavq0/task/tally/schedule.py): Implemented `matches` and `next_run` supporting all 5 cron fields, shortcuts, month/day names, wrapping ranges, steps, `?`, `L`, `NL`, `N#K`, AND semantics between day-of-month and day-of-week, strict validation, and fast jumping search up to the `20 × 365`-day limit.

Verified with `python3 -m unittest` (16/16 passing) as well as additional edge-case checks; no tests, docstrings, or `SCHEDULE.md` were modified.
